text:
Tom (Concordia Bank): Hi all, getting our infra ready for the POC. main asks: can you support JIT SAML provisioning + SCIM bulk sync? we have ~12k employees, want groupless provisioning for some apps and group-based RBAC for others. also need domain proofing for subdomains, and a note on pricing if we need CMK.
Jon (AE): Short: yes to SAML + JIT for logins, yes to SCIM bulk. CMK = Dedicated/Private. Hosted supports JIT assertions and SCIM but CMK is only on Dedicated/Private.
Priya (SE): Details: our Hosted runtime accepts SP-initiated SAML with Assertion Attributes for JIT user creation. SCIM endpoint supports PATCH (recommended) and bulk operations (bulk size limit ~500 users per call). For 12k users we recommend delta syncs (changedSince / syncToken) rather than full pushes.
Anya (Solutions): RBAC: recommend hierarchical roles (org_admin > team_admin > member > read_only). mapping options: Okta group -> Redwood role, or SAML attribute (roles) -> role. If they need complex transforms we can add a small lambda during POC to normalize attributes.
Tom (Concordia Bank): For domain verification they want to use subdomain proofing (we use many subdomains). is DNS TXT per subdomain required or can we use a wildcard?
Priya (SE): We support: (a) DNS TXT on exact host, (b) TXT on apex with a verification token list, or (c) DMARC/administrative email verification in edge cases. For POC we usually ask for a TXT on the specific subdomain. Wildcard verification is only available on Dedicated with enterprise DNS delegation.
Jon (AE): Pricing: propose 30-day Hosted POC with 100k token credit + 3 SE support days. If they require CMK or dedicated SLAs, include Dedicated uplift: one-time CMK onboarding fee + committed monthly capacity. I'll include ballpark numbers in the follow-up.
Anya (Solutions): SCIM details (example):
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer SCIM_TOKEN
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"replace", "path":"roles", "value":["team_admin"]}
  ]
}
```
Use PATCH to update role mappings; PUT is full replace. Bulk example: POST /scim/v2/Bulk with array of Operations (500 max).
Priya (SE): Rate limits for Hosted SCIM: default 120 req/min; request a temporary bump for initial sync via support ticket. For continuous delta syncs, 1-2 req/s should be fine.
Tom (Concordia Bank): Security team wants audit trails for provisioning events and SAML assertion logs retained for 90 days. Hosted keeps auth logs 30 days by default; can we extend for POC?
Anya (Solutions): We can export logs to their SIEM for POC and retain locally 90 days on Dedicated. For Hosted POC: we can arrange a 60-day retention export for the trial.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec-qa/concordia-poc. Please complete SSO, SCIM, RBAC, KMS, and retention sections. Required: SOC2 link, encryption at rest, key mgmt, log retention plan, incident contact.
Jon (AE): POC success criteria ideas: 1) JIT login + user created with correct role, 2) Bulk SCIM delta completes within X hours and matches expected count, 3) RBAC tests for 6 roles pass, 4) DNS verification completed for two sample subdomains, 5) Audit events landed in SIEM.
Tom (Concordia Bank): Can you provide a short infra checklist we can hand to our SREs?
Priya (SE): Checklist (copy/paste):
- Provide IdP metadata XML or SSO endpoints + signing cert
- Confirm SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flow and sign/encrypt settings
- SCIM base URL and scoped token (rotateable)
- Indicate preferred sync method (delta vs full) and expected concurrency (RPS)
- Provide list of subdomains for DNS TXT verification or admin email addresses for DMARC verification
- List Okta groups / attributes and desired Redwood role mapping (CSV ok)
- SIEM endpoint (syslog/HTTPS) for provisioning logs export
- Point of contact for escalation + expected maintenance windows

Anya (Solutions): I'll author a 1-page runbook with the mapping template and sample SCIM payloads and drop to this thread by EOD.
Jon (AE): I'll attach pricing options and Dedicated uplift.
Tom (Concordia Bank): Let's schedule a kickoff tomorrow 9am EST. works for you?
Priya (SE): I can do 9am. I'll bring a small test harness and a SCIM dry-run script.
sec-bot: Note: Hosted SCIM token expiry default = 90 days. For long-lived automation use Dedicated with vault KMS.
Tom (Concordia Bank): Thanks all. will fill the security form and share IdP metadata before the call.
